title: SPC Pack
description: My personal performance pack for Minecraft.
body:
![Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5a61fa317ccadfe69a79a321d33f1e36e6e37491_0.webp)

**SPC Pack** focuses on delivering __essential quality-of-life features and performance optimizations__ without unnecessary bloat. It’s the configuration I personally use for day-to-day Minecraft work. As for a side note, future updates will typically coincide with major Minecraft releases.
